articles.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
articles.snippet: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.

articles.title: People Are Vibe Coding the Ads Out of Their Smart TVs: Here's How
articles.snippet: A viral Claude Code prompt lets Android TV owners switch off sponsored rows and tracking software and build their own home screens, with no root access and every change reversible.
